Name: Genshin Impact Plushies - Sumeru
Author: vikich3rry
Description:
I was decorating my farmhouse after a Stardew break, and spent two minutes looking for a Wanderer plushie before realizing that I had not done it yet. So I made one, and now the whole Sumeru cast is here!
[line]
[b][i][color=#b6d7a8][size=3]Features[/size][/color][/i][/b]
🌱 All [b]14 playable characters from Sumeru [/b][size=1](as of Luna VI)[/size], added as [b]new furniture[/b] placeable both indoors and outdoors
📚 [b]Characters included, [s]in order of release[/s]:[/b] Nahida, Collei, Tighnari, Cyno, Kaveh, Nilou, Wanderer, Dehya, Dori, Candace, Layla, Faruzan and Sethos
🌱 Easily find them in my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39884]Genshin Plushies Catalogue[/url]﻿!
📚 If you don't have my catalogue, they'll be in the [b]Furniture Catalogue[/b] [size=1](search for 'Genshin' or 'Sumeru' if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url])[/size]
🌱 Consolation for when you want a character but the gacha isn't kind to you - at least you can have them in a different game!
📚  [b]i18n compatible![/b] Includes English and Spanish as of 1.0.0
[line]
[b][i][color=#b6d7a8][size=3]Future Plans[/size][/color][/i][/b]
🌱  This will be updated for as long as I'm still into both Stardew and Genshin [size=1](aka a very, [i]very[/i] long time, because I've invested way too much on both to let go)[/size], so [b]new characters will be added as they're released![/b]
📚 [b]Continuing the series![/b]
   ✧ ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38334]Mondstadt[/url]
   ✧ ﻿﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39263]Liyue[/url]
   ﻿✧ Inazuma
   ✧ ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46223]Sumeru[/url] - you're here!
   ✧ ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38492]Fontaine[/url]
   ✧ ﻿Natlan
   ﻿✧ Nod-Krai
   ✧ ﻿Other Factions [size=1](Harbingers, Mages and the Twins will be here!)[/size]
   ✧ ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39884]Paimon Catalogue[/url]
[line]
So I took a very long break, but do not worry, the plushies are not abandoned! I'm preparing the Mondstadt update (Varka and Prune are done, Lohen not yet), and next in line will be the Other Factions (because I need Arlecchino and Scaramouche plushies). After that will be Inazuma, then Nod-Krai and finally Natlan. Hopefully I can lock in during Summer and get them done before Schenznaya, but I make no promises!
Now personal notes aside: Here is your recurrent reminder to get [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35360]Botany of Teyvat[/url] (and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38335]MMMMoT[/url] while you're at it) if you want more Genshin in your game! Honestly I just love those two mods so much I want to share them whenever possible, and these are Genshin themed mods so it's the perfect excuse.
[line]
[color=#d9ead3][size=2]My Sumeru fun fact: Wanderer has been my favorite character in the game since I first saw him as Scaramouche in the 1.1 event! My friends used to say that I had a thing for anemo boys (my faves back then being Venti, Xiao and Kazuha) and I always countered with "but Scara is electro!", so imagine my surprise (and their amusement) when he became playable as an [i]anemo[/i] character LMAO[/size][/color]
[line]
